patterns.name: Search · inspect · compare
patterns.loop: Choose where to look, reveal a clue, compare conditions, explain a useful next move.
patterns.spiral: Habitat need → changed condition → survey/classification → supporting field note.
patterns.limits: Supplied pictures are not field identification or independent scientific observation.

patterns.name: Assemble · allocate · check
patterns.loop: Meet a request with limited materials; count, share, substitute and revise.
patterns.spiral: Equal plates → fractions of a recipe → measured ingredients → prices/change/budgets.
patterns.limits: Matching pretend food preferences does not assess empathy, nutrition or financial judgment.

patterns.name: Change · measure · explain
patterns.loop: Predict, change one thing, run or observe, compare records, explain the limits.
patterns.spiral: Model distance → repeated trials/graphs → water/soil study → energy/sound/light.
patterns.limits: Water Lab is currently authored explanation/illustration; a controlled runoff experiment is not built. Authored models are not physical measurements.

patterns.name: Read · infer · support
patterns.loop: Read or hear a meaningful message; find the clue, infer a purpose, identify supporting words.
patterns.spiral: Explicit note → sequence → inference → compare accounts → evaluate conflicting sources.
patterns.limits: Comprehension selections, narration and additional-language reading do not establish independent decoding or first-language reading level.

patterns.name: Compose · execute · revise
patterns.loop: Make a message or sequence, let a reader/runner respond literally, revise for the intended effect.
patterns.spiral: Word-card directions → branching instructions → short messages → longer authored explanations.
patterns.limits: Finite tap-to-compose clauses are distinct from free writing, handwriting and general programming.

patterns.name: Build · transform · relate
patterns.loop: Make an object/model, transform it, connect its representation to a relation or explanation.
patterns.spiral: Counters/bundles → arrays/inverse relations → fractions/area → algebraic structures.
patterns.limits: A successful answer does not establish recall, fluent calculation or use of an unreported strategy.

patterns.name: Create · perform · reflect
patterns.loop: Make something expressive, try or share it, notice its effect, choose a revision.
patterns.spiral: Rhythm/shape/voice experiment → a composition → explain or perform a revision.
patterns.limits: A dedicated creative-performance loop and reviewed sound/phoneme material are not built. Artistic preference and personal reflection are not numeric attainment scores.

games.name: Number Garden and open math models
games.scope: Seven authored math areas with variants, editable models and optional explanations; sparse task evidence stays separate from placement.

games.name: Multiplication Garden
games.scope: Ordered facts through 12×12 with counting, derivation, help and method distinctions; no timing-based recall certification.

games.name: Living Garden
games.scope: Nine habitat settings, three separately suggested depths in science/notes/math, renewable sealed café parcels. Original visit retained.

games.name: Almost-Right Café
games.scope: Silly ingredient constraints, equal plates, stock shortfall and real inventory; welcome-back dinner/New Game Plus. No assessed money or empathy curriculum.

games.name: Cloud Orchard and gathering hunts
games.scope: Find pretend foods using authored clues/row-column hunts and harvest quantities. Not botanical identification.

games.name: Storm Workshop
games.scope: Controlled ramp/surface model, repeatable authored distances, table and zero-based bars. Not calibrated physics or independent experimental design.

games.name: Water Lab
games.scope: Three authored melting/warming/evaporation missions and molecule pictures tied to the flooded path. Controlled runoff remains planned.

games.name: Willow Post Office
games.scope: Six authored packing orders, editable literal word-card routes, manual flight, revisions, optional reading reports.

games.name: Bramble’s ribbon gate
games.scope: Renewable adaptive +/−/× ribbon tasks, full ordered 12×12 pool, separate examples/decomposition. A component of Post Office, not a separate world.

games.name: English Paris
games.scope: Authored repeatable stories, vocabulary, sequence, inference and evidence selections, with local support and familiarity distinctions.

games.name: French Paris
games.scope: Separate French stories and reading suggestions. No transfer of English decoding or proficiency labels; French is outside Marble’s English organization.

games.name: Word Garden
games.scope: Finite prefix/suffix constructions, authored scenes, spelling exceptions and open discussion. Encounters are not independent reading or spelling evidence. Published with the complete game on Cloudflare.

manualReferences.scope: Match a pictured animal need to damp cover or adult-butterfly nectar and reason about an explicit change. Interdependence, full basic-needs coverage and field investigation are not observed.
Supplied damp/shelter/nectar definitions and microhabitat conditions; broader biome/habitat vocabulary and independent use are unobserved.
Named original portraits and supplied local microhabitat clues; no independent species identification or plant inventory.
Infer which parcel serves hungry neighbors from its described contents; no independent decoding or general inference assessment.
Choose a supplied sentence supporting the parcel choice; does not cover author-argument evaluation or the full source topic.
Count equal packs, with pack count and bites per pack each from 1 through 12, using optional help/method report; no full-topic or recall claim.
Inverse equal-packs task: given total and unit size, find pack count. Does not cover every unknown position or general division.
Count total bites for equal plates and separately handle cupboard gaps; arithmetic help and skipped tasks remain distinct.
Literal equal-bundle arrays and requested decomposition through 12×12; no general division or independent-recall certification.
Generated multiplication examples use equal bundles; addition/subtraction remain their own tasks, not evidence of this topic.

increments.name: Word Workshop
increments.move: New home; reuse build/read, add carefully reviewed speech/sound representations
increments.first: First word-part release published on Cloudflare; reviewed phonics audio and sound/letter activities remain future work.
increments.gap: Current story comprehension does not teach or assess the missing phonics/decoding/transcription sequence.

increments.name: Living Garden field notebook and food webs
increments.first: Compare organisms and conditions, make a simple food-energy chain, return under changed conditions, keep a table and explanatory note.
increments.gap: Current habitat matching omits interdependence, plant needs/growth and extended data collection; later simulations need reviewed assumptions.

increments.name: Café bakery and market
increments.first: Split a recipe into equal parts, measure ingredients, then use pretend prices and change.
increments.gap: Fractions, units and money need new representations and questions; stock counting alone is not those lessons.

increments.name: Willow messages and map-making
increments.first: Write a useful short message, test it with a reader; add a map legend, direction and scale as separately reviewed content.
increments.gap: Current word cards do not demonstrate free composition; geography has no dedicated Marble subject heading.

increments.name: Travelers’ Archive
increments.move: New historical evidence game; reuse read/infer/support and search
increments.first: Compare two short accounts or artifacts, place an event on a timeline/map, explain what each source can and cannot tell us.
increments.gap: History currently has no declared learning activity references; a story setting alone does not teach historical inquiry.

increments.name: Sound and Light Studio
increments.first: Change a sound or shadow, measure a pattern, make a short rhythm or light composition and revise it.
increments.gap: Waves/sound/light and creative music/art need auditory/spatial creation, not only text questions. Recording would need its own privacy decision.

increments.name: Story Loft and community circle
increments.move: New collaborative story/creation home; reuse read/compose/create
increments.first: Tell or compose a short story, consider two perspectives, rehearse a conversation and choose a revision together.
increments.gap: Speaking/listening, extended composition and personal/social reflection need human context. Do not grade empathy, resilience or virtue from game choices.

extensionLimit: Additional subject plans outside the Marble v1 organization; related concepts may already occur within science, history or other source topics. No new nodes or prerequisite edges have been asserted.
